lead.name: Codex
lead.mandate: Rebuild the Gugu Flash AI text-game creation organization, keep scope tied to executable release evidence, and stop maturity claims that are not supported by tests or external signoff.

squads.name: Product Strategy Squad
squads.mission: Own positioning, MVP tradeoffs, release gates, and creator/user loops.

squads.name: Narrative Design Squad
squads.mission: Define text-game grammar, persona voice, endings, remix hooks, and launch content quality.

squads.name: Game Systems Squad
squads.mission: Own scene graph rules, playable choices, completion loops, and hardware-friendly structure.

squads.name: AI Prompt And Model Ops Squad
squads.mission: Own draft prompts, provider fallback, generation provenance, regression fixtures, and model safety boundaries.

squads.name: Frontend Experience Squad
squads.mission: Own Web/H5 creator, feed, player, IP pool, store, device, and operator surfaces.

squads.name: Backend Platform Squad
squads.mission: Own /flash APIs, persistence, auth/session, contracts, operator routes, and integration tests.

squads.name: Safety Rights And Moderation Squad
squads.mission: Own content review, IP rights, asset source statements, reports, appeals, takedowns, and moderation staffing gates.

squads.name: Native And Hardware Squad
squads.mission: Own native shell readiness, device binding, sync evidence, compatibility reports, and Hardware Studio export.

squads.name: Commerce Support And Ops Squad
squads.mission: Own store applications, payment/refund flows, support diagnostics, ticket macros, settlement review, and on-call handoff.

squads.name: QA And Release Squad
squads.mission: Own CI, unit tests, Playwright smoke, release packets, readiness scripts, and regression triage.

squads.name: Content Operations Squad
squads.mission: Own official starter packs, launch content, IP pool hygiene, creator education, and showcase curation.
